scope: finite organizer-image instruction counts calibrating the per-arm deltas; not a production execution or a collision-probability proof
environment: curvesma-reference-count (gcc Debian 14.2.0-19, valgrind 3.24.0, linux/arm64); -O3 -fno-tree-vectorize -mgeneral-regs-only -static; fixed-seed inputs shared by both builds
schedule: rows 1/33/64 are cumulative for the P=64 predecessor schedule (anchor t mod 64 = 0, skip 1..32, plain 33..63); these calibrate the per-arm deltas (skip -2*(B-1)+2, plain +3, anchor -1), which are schedule-independent and reused at P=2048, where only the per-period counts change
